set.body:
## Objective

Port the explicit C/P/J reference from the supplied numerical core with corrected fixed-sampled naming, shifted stable normalization, exact norm, hard contrast gate and finite invalid-patch cost. Define logsumexp posterior alpha weights, exact gradient -z JTu, and PSD EM/GN curvature w JTJ.

## Source and ownership

PRD: `docs/plans/flashalign-implementation-prd.md` (version 2, SHA-256 `a66500fec106a0df0f6635bb81329f44cca0a031cab32958c6c370f2ca6fc929`). Relevant sections/work packages: 6.2, 6.3, FA-02. Original proposal and Python oracles are in `docs/plans/flashalign/` and `docs/plans/flashalign-prd.md`.

Planned paths (reserve exact paths at implementation time):
- `flashalign patch reference tests`
- `PatchObjective`

## Acceptance criteria

1. Finite differences match gradients across polarity priors, tau and outlier floors; epsilon=0 is rejected in production configuration.
2. Gain/offset, low contrast, nonfinite, invalid support, near-correlation-bound and large-offset fixtures pass.
3. The deliberately wrong soft-norm projector formula fails its reference check; oracle remains separately identifiable from production.

## Blocking prerequisites

- B04: FA-B04: Add the experimental Flashalign cross-project and typed API skeleton
- B05: FA-B05: Freeze fixture, tolerance and benchmark evidence specifications

## Evidence and completion

Record exact candidate/provider hashes, relevant commands and outcomes, fixture/config identities, numerical tolerances and all failure cases. Run the task-specific independent checks above and affected JVM/Scala.js/consumer gates; keep timing and scientific accuracy claims separate. Missing required input or a failing admission gate remains blocked, not silently passed. A completed experiment may report no benefit; dependent release/adoption milestones must still assess their own criteria.

## Integration constraints

Use canonical image4s/Ravel/Gale and existing reframe4s map/resample/registration ownership, typed failures and immutable plans with explicit workspaces. Preserve strict compiler policy, current motion/HalfFlow defaults, dirty-tree ownership and frozen experiments. Keep Flashalign linear execution free of nonlinear setup and direct HalfFlow dependencies. Shared primitives migrate through their current owner with both-consumer evidence; do not merge method objectives.
set.title: FA-L01: Implement the scalar patch normalization and sign-mixture oracle
